"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to government bailouts of private institutions.",

"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Belief in the free market as the best tool to sustained prosperity and opportunity for all.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Encouragement of potential buyers to work in concert with the lending community to educate themselves about the responsibilities of purchasing a home, condo, or land.",
